# AGP Nature Villa

> A private 3-bedroom pool villa and homestay in the Aravali hills at Dangiyo Ki Hundar, Udaipur, Rajasthan. The whole villa is booked by one group at a time: up to 15 guests, pets welcome.

## Key facts

- Address: 5, Dangiyo Ki Hundar, near Animal Aid, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313011, India
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?q=24.6802778,73.6234722
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 9892611983
- Email: agpnaturevilla@gmail.com
- Price: ₹15,000 per night for the whole villa. Minimum 2 nights on weekends.
- Check-in 2:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM
- About 20-25 minutes' drive from Udaipur City Palace and Fateh Sagar Lake
- Booking: 30% advance to confirm; refundable security deposit of ₹5,000 - ₹10,000 at check-in. Cancellation: 100% refund (minus 5% bank fee) 15+ days before check-in, 50% at 7-14 days, none under 7 days
- Bedrooms: Love Nest (320 sq ft, couples), Mountain Peak (380 sq ft, upper level, sunrise view), Valley View (350 sq ft, ground floor, garden side, suits families and elders). All have attached bathrooms.
- Shared spaces, all private to the booking group: Blue Wave private pool (242 sq ft, not heated), Laziz indoor kitchen, The Little Paris open-air BBQ kitchen, Infinity Garden (2,000 sq ft walled lawn), Heat Heaven bonfire area
- Pet-friendly, Wi-Fi across the property, free on-site parking, caretaker on site 24/7
- Guest rating 4.9 from 182 reviews
